blocks.goal: Extract TeamCity message formatting and output responsibilities from the event listener to reduce the number of general methods and formatting-related fields in TeamCityPlugin.

ops.details: Extract the TeamCity message templates and formatting state represented by DATE_FORMAT, TEAMCITY_PREFIX, TEMPLATE_ENTER_THE_MATRIX, TEMPLATE_TEST_RUN_STARTED, TEMPLATE_TEST_RUN_FINISHED, TEMPLATE_TEST_SUITE_STARTED, TEMPLATE_TEST_SUITE_FINISHED, TEMPLATE_TEST_STARTED, TEMPLATE_TEST_FINISHED, TEMPLATE_TEST_FAILED, TEMPLATE_TEST_COMPARISON_FAILED, TEMPLATE_TEST_IGNORED, TEMPLATE_BEFORE_ALL_AFTER_ALL_STARTED, TEMPLATE_BEFORE_ALL_AFTER_ALL_FAILED, TEMPLATE_BEFORE_ALL_AFTER_ALL_FINISHED, TEMPLATE_PROGRESS_COUNTING_STARTED, TEMPLATE_PROGRESS_COUNTING_FINISHED, TEMPLATE_PROGRESS_TEST_STARTED, TEMPLATE_PROGRESS_TEST_FINISHED, and TEMPLATE_ATTACH_WRITE_EVENT, together with print(PrintStream-compatible output), formatCommand(String,Object...), and escape(String), into TeamCityMessageFormatter. Preserve the existing output behavior and constructor injection of PrintStream.

Update TeamCityPlugin event handlers and helper methods that call print, formatCommand, or escape to use the extracted TeamCityMessageFormatter instance. Update references to the extracted message templates and extractTimeStamp so that TeamCityPlugin delegates message formatting while retaining event registration and event-specific behavior.

blocks.goal: Extract cohesive test-step naming and location formatting responsibilities from TeamCityPlugin to reduce general methods and simplify event handling.

ops.details: Extract the cohesive step naming and location logic represented by ANNOTATION_GLUE_CODE_LOCATION_PATTERN, LAMBDA_GLUE_CODE_LOCATION_PATTERN, extractLocation(TestStepStarted), javaTestLocationUri(), formatHookStepLocation(HookTestStep,BiFunction<String,String,String>,Function<HookTestStep,String>), getHookName(HookTestStep), extractName(TestStep), and hookNameFormat(HookTestStep) into TeamCityStepFormatter. Preserve the existing handling of PickleStepTestStep, HookTestStep, HookType, Java annotation locations, and Java 8 lambda locations.

Update printTestStepStarted and printTestStepFinished to delegate step name and location calculation to TeamCityStepFormatter. Remove the duplicated private step-formatting methods and regular expression fields from TeamCityPlugin after all references are updated.
